relationships.subject: neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders
relationships.evidence_quote: The NMOSD patients showed significantly higher serum α-CGRP levels than healthy controls

relationships.subject: spinal cord lesions
relationships.evidence_quote: NMOSD patients with spinal cord lesions on magnetic resonance imaging showed significantly higher serum α-CGRP levels compared with those without

key_findings: Serum α-CGRP higher in NMOSD (1.89 vs 1.54 ng/mL, p=0.008), especially with sensory or bowel/bladder dysfunction and spinal lesions.
Elevation in neuropathic pain patients not significant (p=0.120).
